name: hollowmere-art-department
description: Direct, build and review original dark fantasy assets for a PC action RPG in Godot 4, dress levels with a set-decorator tool and generate data-driven cinematics.

defaultPrompt: Design Edda's blue cup for the opening cinematic and its in-game appearance.
Design a modular crypt entrance that stays readable behind a group of enemies.
Review my creature against the art bible and give me a Blender-to-Godot correction pass.
Dress the Hollowmere square like a set decorator and play a cinematic of the approach.
